The challenge

YOUR CLUB HAS OUTGROWN
ITS TOOLS.

PBC runs on WhatsApp groups, word of mouth, and one overworked volunteer who holds everything together. That worked when the club was small. A 10-year club with active members, multi-day tours, and a growing waitlist needs more than a group chat.

📱
WhatsApp Chaos
Ride details get buried under side conversations. Members miss critical updates. The same question — "what time Saturday?" — gets asked every single week. The admin has to answer it every single time.
📅
No Ride Calendar
There is no single, reliable place to see upcoming rides, routes, distances, or pace groups. New members especially struggle — they have no idea what's happening or how to find out without asking.
🧳
Tour Logistics Are a Nightmare
Multi-day excursions like Amashova involve flights, bike transport, accommodation, and gear — coordinated across multiple WhatsApp threads. Things fall through the cracks. Someone always misses something.
📋
Onboarding Is Informal
New members get a document dump on WhatsApp. The constitution and code of conduct exist somewhere — but confirming who has actually read them, or finding the latest version, is impossible to track.

Platform architecture

EVERY MODULE.
ONE PLATFORM.

The platform has three access zones — Public, Member, and Admin. Each serves a different audience. Here is exactly what gets built, what it does, and why it matters for PBC.

Zone 01 — Public
No login · Anyone can access

THE FRONT DOOR.
OPEN TO ALL.

This is what a prospective member sees before joining. It replaces the need for a separate website and keeps Facebook doing what it does best — creating awareness — while the platform handles the structured conversion from interest to formal application.

01 / Discovery
Public Landing

A permanent, always-current public page for PBC. This is the link shared in every Facebook bio, Instagram story, and WhatsApp message. It tells the club's story and points interested people to apply — no DMs needed.

  • Club mission, values and 10-year history
  • What rides look like — pace groups, typical routes
  • Upcoming public ride previews
  • One clear call to action: Apply to Join
MVP
02 / Acquisition
Membership Application

A structured online form that replaces the informal "DM us" process. Every applicant goes through the same intake, their details are saved automatically, and the admin is notified instantly — no more chasing people for information.

  • Full personal details and emergency contact
  • Cycling experience level and discipline
  • How they heard about PBC
  • Automatic WhatsApp and email confirmation on submit
  • Goes straight into the admin pipeline — nothing gets lost
MVP
03 / Pre-Onboarding
Applicant Portal

Once an application is submitted, the applicant gets limited access to read PBC's founding documents before they are formally approved. They arrive on day one having already read and understood the rules — no surprises.

  • Club constitution — read-only access
  • Code of conduct
  • What to expect as a new PBC member
  • Live application status so they know where they stand
V1
Zone 02 — Member
Login required · Active members only

RIDE. PLAN.
BELONG.

The heart of the platform — what every PBC member uses week to week. It replaces the WhatsApp group for all operational matters: who's riding, when, where, and what's needed for the next big tour.

04 / Rides
Ride Calendar

The single source of truth for every PBC ride. Members see what's coming, RSVP with one tap, and get an automatic reminder before the ride. The admin never has to answer "what time Saturday?" again.

  • Full ride details — date, time, distance, route, start point
  • Pace group clearly shown on every ride
  • One-tap RSVP with automatic waitlist if full
  • Attendance logged automatically after each ride
  • WhatsApp reminder sent automatically — no manual effort
MVP
05 / Excursions
Tour & Excursion Logistics

This is the feature no other cycling club tool in South Africa offers. When PBC heads to Amashova, Limpopo, or Hartbeespoort, every piece of logistics lives here — not scattered across six WhatsApp threads where things disappear.

  • Multi-day itinerary with full schedule
  • Accommodation options — each member confirms their booking
  • Flight details — bike transport requirements and baggage notes
  • Per-member checklist — paid, booked, confirmed
  • Shared gear and kit list for the tour
  • Waivers, permits and route files in one place
V1
06 / Profile
Member Profile

A lightweight digital record for every member. Not about bragging rights — about ensuring the right emergency information is always accessible and the admin has a complete picture of who's in the club.

  • Personal details and emergency contact — always current
  • Membership status and join date
  • Ride history — automatically logged from RSVPs
  • Dues payment status
V1
07 / Documents
Club Document Library

Every official PBC document in one place — always the current version. No more searching through old WhatsApp messages for the constitution, or wondering if the indemnity form is still valid.

  • Club constitution and code of conduct
  • Indemnity and waiver forms
  • CyclingSA affiliation documents
  • Admin controls which version is current — members always see the right one
V1
Zone 03 — Admin
Exco & Secretary · Restricted access

COMMAND.
CONTROL.

Everything the club secretary and Exco need to run PBC efficiently — in one dashboard. No more spreadsheets. No more manual WhatsApp reminders. No more chasing dues on a Sunday evening.

08 / Command
Member Management

A complete view of everyone connected to PBC — from first application to active member. The secretary sees everything in one place: who has applied, who is approved, who has paid, and who needs a follow-up.

  • Full application pipeline — pending, approved, active, lapsed
  • Member status management — update, suspend or archive any member
  • Dues and subscription tracking — who has paid and who has not
  • Emergency contact directory for every active member
  • Broadcast announcements to all members or specific groups
MVP
09 / Operations
Ride & Event Builder

The admin creates a ride once. It appears instantly on every member's calendar. RSVPs come in automatically. Reminders go out without anyone lifting a finger. Hours of weekly admin reduced to minutes.

  • Create, edit or cancel any ride in minutes
  • Full excursion builder for multi-day tours with logistics fields
  • Manage RSVPs, capacity and waitlists in real time
  • Post-ride attendance confirmation with one click
  • Trigger a WhatsApp broadcast to all RSVPs directly from the platform
MVP
10 / Intelligence
Club Dashboard

A simple overview of club health for Exco meetings. At a glance: how many members are active, how are rides being attended, and what is the dues collection rate. Data that used to live in someone's head — now visible to everyone on Exco.

  • Active members vs pending applications
  • Ride attendance trends over time
  • Dues collection rate — current month and year to date
  • Upcoming events overview
V2

How This Works

We believe in full transparency. Here is exactly what this partnership means for both sides.

PBC funds the build
Your investment covers the development of the platform. What you receive is purpose-built for your club — not a website, not a template. A working operational tool worth significantly more than what you pay for it at founding-partner rates.
Maru Online retains the platform IP
Maru Online owns the underlying platform technology. PBC owns their branded instance and all their club data — completely and permanently. If you ever leave, your data leaves with you.
PBC shapes version 1
Real feedback from real Saturday rides drives the first six months of development. You are not a beta tester — you are a co-creator with a direct line to the people building it.
Founding rate is locked forever
As more clubs join, the price goes up for them. Yours stays exactly where it is today — permanently. That is the founding partner advantage.
